body:
The truth is, getting caught for pot isn't the biggest deal any more. All I would get is a slap on the wrist and a period where I would occasionally tested for pot. That seems almost laughably funny. However, at the same time, when I'm abstaining I can't help but notice that the world is just a little bit less sunny.
The news is, JWH-018 is a drug that is going to quickly (probably) shortly enter an unlegal state and that almost perfectly replaces marijuana. Other than its being too small to get a truly impressive 'puff,' the powder can fulfill nearly every cannibus need.
I smoked about two knife tips off of a hotplate with a straw and found the smoke neither harsh or unpleasant. If anything the taste reminded me of the smell of an empty room freshener. Plasticky and just a bit suspicious.
